messages:
tom: Heads-up 10m: Sales wants language in the SDK changelogs around embedding vector dimension changes. We have a potential breaking change if model X moves from 1536->2048 dims.

lina: Oof. That's going to break downstream rerank/nearest-neighbor indices if they don't reindex.

oliver: Two main paths: 1) bump major version & clearly deprecate old embeddings; 2) keep same API but include a migration helper that maps old vectors (pad/truncate) and emits a warning.

priya: From docs POV, we should do both: a migration guide + code examples in TS/Py, plus a clear changelog entry and a small FAQ: "When will I need to reindex?".

lina: Architecturally, padding is lossy and can ruin similarity. We should not recommend it as default. Migration helper for quick tests only.

oliver: Agreed. Suggest: default = error + user-facing message (needs reindex). Provide opt-in compatibility shim in SDK named `embeddings.compat.padTo(2048)` but mark experimental.

priya: Examples needed: batch reindex script (Py + TS) that streams existing docs, calls new embedding endpoint, and writes to a new index. Keep snippet < 15 lines for docs.

tom: Also need to coordinate with rerank team: rerank models assume dim parity. If customers upgrade embeddings but not rerank model, might see perf regression.

lina: Let's add launch criteria: 1) Changelog entry with migration guidance; 2) reindex example scripts in both languages; 3) SDK opt-in shim (experimental flag); 4) telemetry event when compatibility shim used.

oliver: Who owns the shim? I'll take TS shim. Priya can add Py wrapper. Lina will prepare wording about risk/perf. Tom will coordinate comms with Sales + CS.

priya: For tests: unit tests for shim behavior, and an integration smoke that runs on small dataset to show before/after similarity scores. Keep CI opt-out for heavy tests.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs checklist template available at /docs/templates/migration-checklist.md (auto).

priya: For changelog format: use the new SDK CHANGELOG.md convention: header `## [Unreleased] - 2026-05-04` then `### Changed` + `### Deprecated` etc. Include migration snippet and recommended timeline for reindexing.

oliver: One more thing: function-calling structured outputs may also embed vectors in payloads for hybrid search. Need to document that embedding dim mismatch can affect those flows. Add a short note in "Advanced" section.

lina: Can we offer a short-term Dedicated/Private advisory script for customers to run reindex on-prem? Sales asked for an ops-friendly script (bash + curl).

tom: I'll draft a lightweight bash example and attach to the migration guide.

priya: Timeline: docs + changelog draft by Tue EOD, TS shim PR by Thu, Py shim PR by Fri, internal beta next Monday. Is that feasible?

oliver: Depends on TS workload, but ok. I'll open a WIP PR today and tag reviewers.

lina: Add an acceptance criterion: perf regression <2% for rerank on our golden dataset after migration. If >2% we flag for model team.

tom: Good metric. Also add a note to contact support for instance-based migration assistance.

priya: I'll add the support CTA and sample email template for CS.

docs-bot: publish-draft scheduled: migration-guide/embeddings-dim-change -> draft assigned to priya on 2026-05-05T10:00:00Z.
